# DID Field Guide

> Standards-first research on decentralized identifiers (DIDs), security, method selection, implementation patterns, and an experimental Veilid-backed method proposal.

Important status note: `did:vld` is a research proposal in this repository. It is not a registered DID method, a Veilid Foundation specification, a working resolver, or production-ready software.

## Primary paths

- [Start here](https://bradleymatera.github.io/dids/)
- [DIDs, clearly](https://bradleymatera.github.io/dids/overview/)
- [Project status](https://bradleymatera.github.io/dids/status/)
- [Compare DID methods](https://bradleymatera.github.io/dids/methods/)
- [Security and privacy](https://bradleymatera.github.io/dids/security/)
- [Implementation path](https://bradleymatera.github.io/dids/implementations/)
- [did:vld proposal](https://bradleymatera.github.io/dids/methods/did-vld/)
- [Standards tracker](https://bradleymatera.github.io/dids/future/)
- [Sources and glossary](https://bradleymatera.github.io/dids/reference/)

## Editorial policy

Claims are separated into stable standards, active drafts, analysis, design proposals, and test plans. Conceptual code is not presented as a runnable implementation. Pages include a reviewed date and link to primary sources where practical.
